purpose: Visual comparison of generated fixture previews against official product-reference images; record substantive lens or silhouette mismatches only.
coverage_note: The requested brand/model contact sheets contain 16 identifiable source/model pairs in this scope. No seventeenth requested mid-catalog pair was present in the listed ACME, Astera, Elation, ETC jr, HES, Cameo, PROLIGHTS, and Rogue R3/R3X sheets.

findings.observation: Resolved in the revised preview: it now shows four concave reflectors, matching the four visible optics in the manufacturer image. Front-view inspection confirms the small source points are centered in their cups; the earlier apparent offset was three-quarter-view parallax.
findings.recommended_focus: No further change requested for the four-cup layout or emitter positions.

findings.observation: Resolved in the revised preview: the unsupported square plate is gone and the model now presents the circular lens/rim at the end of the zoom barrel, consistent with the official image.
findings.recommended_focus: No further change requested for this finding.

findings.observation: Resolved in the revised preview: it now shows three broad concave reflectors and the requested floor-yoke. Front-view inspection confirms the small source points are centered in their cups; the earlier apparent offset was three-quarter-view parallax.
findings.recommended_focus: No further change requested for the three-cup layout, emitter positions, or floor-yoke.

findings.observation: In the front orthographic preview the outer PAR head/optical face reads vertically oval; the official product reference shows a round front housing and face.
findings.recommended_focus: Check round housing proportions independently of the full fixture's dimension envelope; preserve the sourced overall dimensions while keeping the PAR face circular.

findings.observation: The AX5 front orthographic preview has a markedly vertically elongated/oval housing face, whereas the manufacturer's TriplePAR face and reflector group are circular.
findings.recommended_focus: Restore a circular optical housing/face while retaining the dimensioned overall envelope and separate floor-yoke.

reviewed_fixtures.result: no specific blocking lens/silhouette discrepancy recorded
three cups, centered emitters and floor-yoke verified; front housing circularity remains open
square plate removal verified; prior finding resolved
four reflectors and centered emitters verified; front housing circularity remains open
no substantive lens/silhouette issue noted; multi-lens face arrangement is recognizably consistent

limitations: Visual QA only; no changes were made to the parent worktree or generated models.
Review covered contact sheets and available front/three-quarter PNG previews, not Blender mesh inspection or in-app runtime viewing.
A blank model.joints field was not used as an articulation failure criterion.
